final_message: Incorporated re-grade findings F001-F005 and unmet DC-003 into pm-quality-management-plan (record format and check order, post-release value review row, split value-nonconformity rows, undecided table narrowed to storage locations, PM schedule responsibility) and updated the PJR-Y5AC ticket response and work table; re-grade left open for orchestrator.
handoff: status: kept `ready` while revising (same reason as the previous round: content reinforcement without changing chapter structure or frontmatter); final confirmation by a human at 140.

Executor decided the trial / post-release value record format (one record per condition ID with measurement-method reference, measured value, pass/fail/hold) and the check order (BA -> QE -> PM -> PO) in the plan itself, derived from existing evidence items, pm-plan decision gates and RACI; PO should approve this at 140.
Storage locations for trial records and post-release value records remain `_UNDECIDED_:` because no declared source supports a concrete path.
SC-04 to SC-06 observation timing is deferred to the success criteria's judgment periods; no numeric values were added.
Ticket work-table row 4 (re-run `grade run --target deliverable` and record result) left open for the orchestrator; it cannot run from the executor sandbox.
